data.body:
AC amendment (gap-analysis: implicit_assumption): Specify parent-filtered bug query in closure check script.

The closure check script (check-a34c-closure.sh) must filter bugs by --parent=a34c-b345-1e63-4ae3, not by 'has detected_by tag' alone — otherwise bugs from other epics with detected_by tags could produce a false PASS.

The exact CLI query for criterion (a) must be:
  .claude/scripts/dso ticket list --type=bug --parent=a34c-b345-1e63-4ae3

Then filter the JSON output for at least one record whose tags array contains a value matching ^detected_by:(tests|review-llm|review-human|production|user-report|internal-dogfood|other)$.

The test-check-a34c-closure.sh stubs MUST simulate this parent-filtered query in all three scenarios (happy, missing-fixture, missing-tagged-bug).

Additional verify step: grep -qE 'parent.*a34c-b345-1e63-4ae3|a34c-b345-1e63-4ae3.*parent' plugins/dso/scripts/check-a34c-closure.sh
